Hi all,

I reviewed FinInsight's redline and attached Redwood_Proposed_DPA_redline.docx with inline comments. High level summary and open items below so we can keep Procurement moving: 

Open/negotiable items (summary):
- Cross-border transfer language: We can accept EU SCCs as baseline; propose an Annex describing our subprocessor list and a quarterly update cadence rather than embedding the full list in the DPA.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood will sign a BAA if the customer selects Redwood Private or a dedicated deployment with the documented controls. For hosted/pilot environments, we can accept limited PHI with data minimization terms but cannot sign a full BAA without Private deployment.
- Retention: 12 months for logs is materially higher than our default 90 days. Proposed compromise: 90 days for system logs + 12 months for customer-requested audit artifacts (by exception, on paid plan). Will need Finance approval for cost impact.
- Audit rights: limit to annual SOC 2 report review and scoped onsite audits with 30 days' notice. We won't allow continuous monitoring without mutual NDA and scoping.
- Breach notification: Redwood's standard is 72 hours for security incidents affecting customer data; will accept 72-hour SLA in DPA.

Requested confirmables for FinInsight:
- Can you confirm whether the pilot will include PHI at all, even de-identified derivatives?
- Procurement: will FinInsight accept DocuSign execution and a consolidated PO (we prefer a single PO referencing the final SOW + DPA)?

I've flagged a few legal redlines in the attached docx — please review and let me know what FinInsight can concede. If FinInsight insists on full 12-month logging for all tiers or wants us to accept HIPAA in hosted tier, we will need an exec-level exception and a pricing delta.

Schedule: If FinInsight can accept the proposed compromises, we can finalize and prepare a DocuSign envelope within 24 business hours of confirmation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

- Retention: FinInsight is flexible to accept the 90-day default for system logs for the pilot if we can commit to a documented upgrade path and a scoped 12-month retention option in the contract for production.

I'll loop my procurement contact (procure@fininsight.com) into the final steps. If you can prepare the agreed redline and DocuSign envelope, we aim to sign by the end of day Monday.
